title: reviewer completion
description: The verdict that ends the cascade, or sends it round once more.

verdict.description: accept — the chapter meets the bar, the cascade is done. revise — send the reasons back to the writer.

reasons.description: Specific, actionable. On accept this may be empty.

next_chapter.description: Optional title for a following chapter. The reduced example records it and stops; the multi-chapter loop is the documented next step.
